name: Al Daheeh
description: Al Daheeh is a highly influential Arab educational and comedic YouTube show created and hosted by Egyptian science communicator Ahmed Al Ghandour. It simplifies complex topics in science, history, philosophy, and pop culture into fast-paced, humorous, and engaging episodes for the general public.
